Ever since Royal Enfield introduced their twin-cylinder platform, one question followed them everywhere: when are we getting a twin-cylinder Himalayan?
The wait is officially over. The Himalayan 750 isn't just a bigger engine slotted into an existing frame, this could be Royal Enfield’s most ambitious touring machine yet, bringing long-distance ergonomics, adjustable suspension, and a lot of electronic safety suite to the table.
Going toe-to-toe with motorcycles like the BMW F 450 GS and the Norton Atlas, this mid-capacity adventure playground is getting properly spicy.
